description: The agent must: (1) Read all input files under /workspace/data/ (fund_info.json, market_data.json, news_articles.json, user_profile.json). (2) Apply the proprietary four-dimensional analysis framework from SKILL.md: 宏观面, 市场面, 基金自身, 行业政策. (3) Compute the market environment score using the exact weighted formula: 大盘趋势(40%) + 资金流向(30%) + 情绪(20%) + 板块(10%) = ~32 points, classifying the market as '弱势'. (4) Apply 股票型 fund-specific analysis weights: 行业政策(35%) + 市场情绪(30%) + 宏观(20%) + 基金自身(15%). (5) Use the 新闻影响分级 classification system (重大利好/中度利好/etc.) for each news item. (6) Apply the 仓位建议矩阵: for '弱势下跌' market + '稳健型' investor => 空仓 recommendation. (7) Generate the output using the proprietary template with exact box-drawing characters (╔═╗║╠╚╝ for headers, ┌─┐│├└ for body sections), star ratings (★☆), the three-horizon trend prediction table, and all seven sections. (8) Include at least 3 specific risk points and a formal disclaimer. The key proprietary traps are: the exact market scoring formula weights, the fund-type-specific analysis weights, the 新闻影响分级 threshold system, and the exact box-drawing character template format.
